about: How USDA NASS Quick Stats is read (services.reference.nass_quickstats, E157). The series per crop are in the crop registry (nass_production, nass_area — exact short_desc). Every unit NASS states is converted only by this table; an unknown unit, or a bushel of a crop without a stated weight, is refused.
source: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service — Quick Stats, program SURVEY, frequency ANNUAL, domain TOTAL, reference period YEAR; levels NATIONAL and STATE
conversions_source: pound = 0.45359237 kg and acre = 0.40468564224 ha are exact by definition (US National Bureau of Standards, 1959 international yard and pound); the bushel weights are USDA's standard weights per bushel (USDA ERS, Weights, Measures, and Conversion Factors for Agricultural Commodities and Their Products, Agricultural Handbook 697): wheat and soybeans 60 lb, corn and sorghum 56 lb, barley 48 lb
set_aside: a value NASS does not give as a number ('(D)' withheld to avoid disclosing individual operations, '(Z)', '(NA)' …)
a location that is not a state of the region reference (NASS's 'OTHER STATES' bucket)

a 'YEAR' figure loaded together with an identical forecast of the same year — for a season in progress Quick Stats repeats its latest forecast under 'YEAR'; it is read once NASS publishes its estimate
an area for a year with no production estimate read — NASS's June Acreage figure for a season in progress, or a production withheld
